svg.title: Four-Step MSO and ABS Setup Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-mso-abs-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Four-Step MSO and ABS Setup Roadmap; subtitle: Entity split, fee structure, buyer vetting and Arizona compliance; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Split the two companies; deliverable: Licensed professional entity owns the practice; an MSO anyone can own is linked by a management service agreement; gate: Non-lawyers never practice law, mirroring the CPOM rule Jackson LLP describes; week: Week 2; title: Set the MSA fee; deliverable: Flat monthly fee or cost plus fair margin; gate: Any percentage of law-firm revenue is a no-go (Holt Law); week: Week 3; title: Vet the buyer; deliverable: Benchmark offers against 6-8x profit market multiples versus a 4x offer; gate: Walk from any pitch that controlling intake means controlling the firm; Shelton rejected about 90% of 70-plus PE-backed MSOs; week: Week 4; title: File for the Arizona ABS track; deliverable: Compliance lawyer with management experience, 10% ownership disclosure, Arizona-admitted lawyer handling intake and records; gate: Plan for approval of about 4 months, now 6-8 months; caption: Healthcare and law-firm practitioners describe the same split between the licensed entity and the management company.; assumptions note: Week labels sequence the setup and do not reflect regulator timelines; Rodriguez ran March to August while others report 6 to 8 month queues.; note: Sources: Jackson LLP Healthcare Lawyers (wUqthLNx6Ro), Holt Law (DNk78wbKy5s), Frederick Shelton on Ten Golden Rules (I4F5OYZQJuU), Lynda Shely on Law Leaders (Tvn12qG9i5s), The Heart of Law Podcast (poe1CAsUc4U, OdPOa3osKC0).
